typeAdaptations: TemporalAdapter<TObject = TemporalSupportedObject> and DateBuilderReturnType<T, TObject = TemporalSupportedObject> add an optional generic parameter; their default shapes remain source-equivalent. Concrete Date/DateTime specialization prevents accidental cross-library arithmetic after simultaneous augmentation.
Both adapters augment baseui-solid2/internals/temporal; Luxon's formerly commented registration is active. Generic core imports neither adapter nor date-library types.

The source non-distributive [T] extends [null] conditional is deliberately unchanged: string|null statically maps to the date object although runtime null returns null. The four consumer fixtures explicitly preserve this source limitation.

Luxon fromJSDate installed declarations accept zone but omit runtime locale. Pass a structurally typed options variable with both properties; no assertion or diagnostic suppression. Runtime locale test passes.

Luxon's fullMonthAndYear runtime token was outside the upstream annotated shared interface. Its concrete formats property is now TemporalAdapterFormats & {fullMonthAndYear:string}; shared format keys remain unchanged.
TS cannot narrow a generic conditional return from a null check; localized casts retain the conditional return contract. Date-fns TZDate branch uses the same unknown bridge as upstream.

Generic interface broad nullable/range parameter signatures remain unchanged in meaning; concrete adapter methods retain the narrower source signatures. Do not assume Luxon accepts range objects at runtime.

Vitest Matchers uses the installed single type parameter, unlike upstream's two-parameter declaration. Recursive Luxon tuple checks assert each endpoint, exact arity and negative null/scalar assignments rather than relying on alias identity.
